headline: Saudi Transport and Logistics Commercial Registrations Surge 31% in Q3
summary: Commercial registrations in Saudi Arabia's transport and storage sector climbed 31% year-on-year to 185,554 by the end of Q3 2026, with road freight transport licenses surging 52%.
why: Expanding logistics infrastructure is a core pillar of Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 strategy to establish the Kingdom as a global multimodal trade transit hub.

impacts.name: Saudi Logistics
impacts.why: A 31% increase in transport registrations reflects rapid investment and activity in national logistics corridors.
